verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents its own official client SDKs and client library, including SSR clients for Next.js and SvelteKit, automatic access-token handling on API calls, and an `accessToken` option for third-party JWTs. Community reports show gaps in platform coverage: one user wanted a first-party iOS SDK, and a React Native developer found no OAuth getting-started guide and fell back to Expo AuthSession. missing for 10: an enumerated list of official SDK languages and platforms, evidence of first-party mobile/iOS SDK coverage, RN OAuth guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
